recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓幾乎被小淋巴球完全取代，只剩零星巨核細胞與脂肪空泡，其間可見較淡染的模糊區塊（增生中心，proliferation centers），是 CLL/SLL 瀰漫性骨髓侵犯的樣貌。
features: Packed marrow with near-total replacement by a monotonous population of small dark lymphocytes
Vague, paler-staining zones suggestive of proliferation centers (larger cells with more cytoplasm)
Only scattered residual megakaryocytes and few fat spaces
Diffuse growth pattern without discrete follicles
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse replacement by small lymphocytes. Vague pale zones composed of slightly larger cells, suggestive of proliferation centers, interrupt the dark background. Residual hematopoiesis is reduced to scattered megakaryocytes, and fat is nearly absent. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows paratrabecular aggregates of cleaved centrocytes and is CD10/BCL6 positive, rather than diffuse replacement with pale proliferation centers.
Mantle cell lymphoma lacks true proliferation centers and is cyclin D1 positive.
Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma contains plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased mast cells and usually an IgM paraprotein, and is CD5/CD23 negative.
